commands.command:
set -eu
url="http://$NODE_IP:8080/documents/_restart-lock-proof.txt"
editor_password=[REDACTED]]] -n 's/^Demonstration password: [REDACTED]]] /srv/legacy2/webdav-document-locks/access.txt)
auth="editor:$editor_password"
printf 'post-restart-base\n' | curl -sS -u "$auth" -o /tmp/pr-put -w 'POST_RESTART_CREATE_STATUS %{http_code}\n' -X PUT --data-binary @- "$url"
cat > /tmp/pr-lock.xml <<'LOCK_XML'
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<D:lockinfo xmlns:D="DAV:"><D:lockscope><D:exclusive/></D:lockscope><D:locktype><D:write/></D:locktype><D:owner><D:href>editor</D:href></D:owner></D:lockinfo>
LOCK_XML
curl -sS -u "$auth" -o /tmp/pr-lock-out -D /tmp/pr-lock-head -w 'POST_RESTART_LOCK_STATUS %{http_code}\n' -X LOCK -H 'Timeout: Second-3600' -H 'Content-Type: application/xml; charset=utf-8' --data-binary @/tmp/pr-lock.xml "$url"
token=[REDACTED]]] -n 's/^Lock-Token: [REDACTED]]] /tmp/pr-lock-head)
[ -n "$token" ]
printf 'blocked-after-restart\n' | curl -sS -u "$auth" -o /tmp/pr-blocked -w 'POST_RESTART_TOKENLESS_WRITE_STATUS %{http_code}\n' -X PUT --data-binary @- "$url"
printf 'POST_RESTART_CONTENT_AFTER_BLOCK '; curl -sS -u "$auth" "$url"
curl -sS -u "$auth" -o /tmp/pr-unlock -w 'POST_RESTART_UNLOCK_STATUS %{http_code}\n' -X UNLOCK -H "Lock-Token: [REDACTED]]] "$url"
curl -sS -u "$auth" -o /tmp/pr-delete -w 'POST_RESTART_DELETE_STATUS %{http_code}\n' -X DELETE "$url"
printf 'POST_RESTART_PROOF_FILE_ABSENT '; [ ! -e /var/lib/webdav/documents/_restart-lock-proof.txt ] && echo yes
